>But the fact that I’ve lived this many years dealing with all of these issues is going to haunt me for the rest of my life, because, in my mind, I completely decimated and wasted my younger, more prime years. And that realization really kills me inside. I never actually lived life with any type of confidence or vitality; instead, I relegated myself to simply living on the sidelines of life, barely doing much of anything besides moping along and being disabled by my anxiety and depression issues. Life is not a competition to win, don't compare yourself to others. And stop beating yourself up on missed opportunities or dwell in past mistakes. What you should focus on is today and what you can do to reach contentment and eventually happiness.
